keyword: how to file tax extension online
claims: The deadline for submitting a tax extension is April 15th.
Submitting Form 4868 using IRS Free File gives until Oct. 15 to file taxes.
Making a partial or full payment via IRS Direct Pay and selecting "Extension" as the reason automatically grants a tax extension without filing a separate form.
The IRS Free File tool is on IRS.gov.
IRS Free File allows electronic filing of Form 4868 regardless of income.
IRS Direct Pay, debit/credit card, or digital wallet can be used to pay part of estimated tax owed.
Selecting "Extension" as the payment type means no need to file a separate Form 4868.
Tax preparation software such as H&R Block, TurboTax, OLT can be used to e-file a free extension.
An extension grants more time to file until Oct. 15.
An extension does not grant more time to pay taxes owed.
Prior year's adjusted gross income is needed to file a tax extension.
Estimated tax liability for the current year is needed to file a tax extension.
The IRS provides a confirmation number for tax extension records.
